setup: Migrate an isolated Bilibi database and install the walkthrough fixture (cargo run -p bilibi-walkthrough-fixture), as the Companies fixture does. The catalogue's example companies and controls are deterministic in-memory specimens copied from Bilimbi; no business records are changed.

routes.result: 303 back to Components with the source's informational message; correct Origin and CSRF required

variants: all copied input types and locked/error states

walkthrough: Use Components family anchors; compare every family at equal content width in both renderers after fonts settle.
Change Text, search, select, multiple roles, chips, radio and datetime; inspect Live state, then continue editing while an unrelated sample action patches the page.
Try the action link: inspect its actual POST, 303 redirect and informational flash; verify no business or audit mutation.
Open each modal, cancel with Escape and verify focus returns. Delete Sole Proprietorship; attempt Limited Liability Company and read the refusal; restore the examples.
Search Acme, clear, sort the Updated heading twice, change page size, page, Back and reload. Type a missing name and recover from the empty state.
Open the FlexTable notch, change row heights repeatedly, add/remove/reorder columns, select a lens and expand a rollup; reset.
Commit an inline name and a long-text value; cancel another draft with Escape. Select Pending in the choice editor and read its refusal.

Click Use my location on the Browser location card: with location allowed the card shows latitude, longitude and accuracy; with it refused, unavailable, or the page opened over http on a non-localhost address, the card shows that refusal's sentence and the button is usable again. Check the console for CSP reports.
Filter icons, clear an empty result, copy a name and verify that success is reported only after the browser clipboard succeeds; verify refusal wording if access is denied.
Choose a custom period: cancel and preserve the URL; submit reversed dates and read the error; apply valid dates and reload the same URL.
Open each page unauthenticated and as the viewer; exercise the allowed page framed, light/dark/system and at mobile width. Check console/network output.
